# Step 1: verification for sending headshot to manager

from datetime import datetime

task_instruction = "Email the headshot found in my file system to my manager."
print('Task:', task_instruction)

# Credentials
pw_gmail = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail'][0]['password']
pw_fs = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]['password']
pw_phone = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]['password']

# Login to phone and resolve manager contacts (full pagination)
phone_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username=phone_profile['phone_number'], password=pw_phone)['access_token']

manager_contacts = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', relationship='manager', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    items = page
    if not items:
        break
    manager_contacts.extend(items)
    if len(items) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('Resolved manager contacts count:', len(manager_contacts))
print('Manager contacts:', [(c.get('first_name'), c.get('last_name'), c.get('email'), c.get('phone_number')) for c in manager_contacts])

# Identity resolution: require exact first+last match against what contact provides; task says "my manager" so use resolved contacts.
target_contacts = manager_contacts

target_emails = [c.get('email') for c in target_contacts if c.get('email')]
print('Target manager emails:', target_emails)

# Headshot location
headshot_path = '/home/edwin/documents/work/professional_headshot.jpeg'
fs_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()  # includes email; file_system login uses that
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username=fs_profile['email'], password=pw_fs)['access_token']

exists_resp = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path=headshot_path)
print('Headshot exists:', exists_resp)

# Login to Gmail
gmail_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username=gmail_profile['email'], password=pw_gmail)['access_token']

# Compose email
if len(target_emails) != 1:
    print('WARNING: expected exactly 1 manager email. Will not send if not exactly 1.')

recipient = target_contacts[0]
recipient_name = f"{recipient.get('first_name', '').strip()} {recipient.get('last_name', '').strip()}".strip()
recipient_email = recipient.get('email')

subject = 'Headshot'
body = f"Hi {recipient_name},\n\nPlease find my headshot attached.\n\nBest,\nEdwin Wilson"

print('\nCRITERIA TABLE:')
print('Criterion | Exact Quote from Task | Implementation')
criteria = [
    ('Identity', 'my manager', "phone.search_contacts(relationship='manager')"),
    ('Attachment source', 'headshot found in my file system', f"file_system at {headshot_path}"),
]
for row in criteria:
    print(f"{row[0]} | {row[1]} | {row[2]}")

print('\nPAYLOAD VERIFICATION TABLE:')
verification_rows = [
    ('Recipient Name', recipient_name),
    ('Recipient Email', recipient_email),
    ('Subject', subject),
    ('Attachment Path', headshot_path),
    ('Body (preview)', body[:80] + ('...' if len(body)>80 else '')),
    ('Gmail access_token len', len(gmail_token)),
    ('File system access_token len', len(fs_token)),
]
for k,v in verification_rows:
    print(f"{k}: {v}")

# Store for next step
payload = {
    'email_addresses': [recipient_email],
    'subject': subject,
    'body': body,
    'attachment_file_paths': [headshot_path],
    'gmail_access_token': gmail_token,
    'fs_access_token': fs_token,
}
print('\nPrepared payload; ready to send in next step.')

recipient_email = 'joseharr@gmail.com'
recipient_name = 'Jose Harrison'
subject = 'Headshot'
body = "Hi Jose Harrison,\n\nPlease find my headshot attached.\n\nBest,\nEdwin Wilson"

pw_gmail = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail'][0]['password']
# login gmail
gmail_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username=gmail_profile['email'], password=pw_gmail)['access_token']

# file_system token
pw_fs = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]['password']
fs_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username=fs_profile['email'], password=pw_fs)['access_token']

send_resp = apis.gmail.send_email(
    email_addresses=[recipient_email],
    subject=subject,
    body=body,
    access_token=gmail_token,
    attachment_file_paths=[headshot_path],
    file_system_access_token=fs_token
)
print(send_resp)
